question: A sold an item to B at a gain of 25% and B sold it to C at a loss of 10%. If C paid ₹6,520 for it, then the cost price of the item for A was:
solution:
Given:

A sold an item to B at a gain of 25%

B sold it to C at a loss of 10%

Total money paid by C = Rs. 6520

**Formula used**

S.P = C.P(1 +/- r/100)

where, r = gain/loss%

Calculation:

Let, the A paid for the item = x

So, x × (125/100) × (90/100) = 6520

⇒ x = 6520 × (100/125) × (100/90)

⇒ x = 5795(5)/(9)

∴ A paid Rs. **5795(5)/(9)** (in Rs.) for the item.
